technology_name: RUTIN AND LINOLENIC ACID BASED COMPOSITION TO MIMIC THE EFFECTS OF CALORIE RESTRICTION FOR NEUROLOGICAL DISORDERS
institution: National Institute of Technology Calicut (NIT Calicut)
problem_solved: Central nervous system tissue degradation from age-regulated disorders displays a lack of effective pharmaceutical interventions capable of supplying broad-spectrum neuroprotective protection.
description: A targeted pharmaceutical small-molecule composition combining rutin with linolenic acid components, structurally engineered to mimic calorie restriction benefits and maximize the expression of brain-protection genes.
applications: Clinical neurodegenerative therapies, anti-aging cognitive decline protocols, cerebrovascular condition management, and specialized neuro-intensive care pharmaceuticals.
secondary_sector: MedTech & Health Care, Consumer & Lifestyle Products
